Container.Name: PrintStash
Container.Overview: PrintStash is a self-hosted 3D print library and G-code vault. This image runs the web UI and API together. Open the WebUI on a trusted network and create the first administrator account. The appdata path stores the database, uploaded files, thumbnails, staging files, and backups. Add existing model folders as separate Library sources after setup; do not use an existing library as the appdata path.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: 3d printer 3d printing model manager stl library 3mf gcode bgcode step stp obj cad file organizer self hosted docker nas klipper moonraker octoprint prusalink bambu elegoo spoolman orcaslicer prusaslicer cura print history
Container.Requires: Open first-run setup only on a trusted network; the first registrant becomes administrator. When moving from the old two-container install, record the old API data owner first, then stop both old containers. Set advanced PUID and PGID to that same owner (the old image usually used 10001:10001); otherwise existing Library sources can become unreadable. Follow the migration guide.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port to open PrintStash in your browser.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Dedicated persistent folder for the database, managed files, thumbnails, staging, and backups. Do not map an existing model library here.

Config.Name: First-run setup
Config.Description: Allows the first administrator to register from a trusted local network. Registration closes after the first account is created.

Config.Name: Settings restart
Config.Description: Allows Settings to restart the supervised application container.

Config.Name: User ID
Config.Description: Numeric owner for appdata and mounted Library sources. Default is Unraid's nobody user. On upgrade, use the old API data owner's UID to keep existing Library sources readable.

Config.Name: Group ID
Config.Description: Numeric group for appdata and mounted Library sources. Default is Unraid's users group. On upgrade, use the old API data owner's GID to keep existing Library sources readable.
